ItemID: NA; Title: Muddy Wolf at Red Rocks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues sound fits my interests, but I am more interested in a studio album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Out Among The Stars; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Johnny Cash appeals to my country interests, though it is not my first choice this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for more of Clapton's relaxed blues sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: lullaby and... The Ceaseless Roar; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for straightforward blues and roots music rather than a more exploratory sound today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loud Hailer; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar focus appeals to my Hendrix interest, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: From A Room: Volume 1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country and soul direction sounds appealing, but I am only choosing a couple of albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hitchhiker; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The stripped-down songwriting could suit my taste, but I am more drawn to blues right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bear's Sonic Journal: Live at Fillmore East 1970; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough about the performers to make me want to explore it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent listening to Clapton and Hendrix, so I would try this album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blue Smoke; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country direction fits part of my listening, but my interest is more firmly on blues this visit.
